name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short text hint for a control that opens on hover after a delay and on keyboard focus, and closes with Escape, on Radix, Base UI or React Aria.
label: Labs examples
author: Design From Labs <https://labs.designfrom.com>

props.name: TooltipProvider delayDuration / delay
props.description: Radix and Base UI: milliseconds of hover before a tooltip opens; shared by every tooltip inside the provider.

props.name: TooltipContent side
props.description: Radix and Base UI: where the hint appears relative to the trigger.

props.name: TooltipTrigger delay
props.description: React Aria: milliseconds of hover before it opens.

props.name: Tooltip placement
props.description: React Aria: where the hint appears; start and end follow the reading direction.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the hint bubble.

a11y: Follows the WAI-ARIA tooltip pattern: role=tooltip, linked to the trigger with aria-describedby.
Opens on keyboard focus and closes on blur or Escape.
Keep the hint short and non-interactive; use a popover for links or buttons.
The fade animates opacity only and is disabled when the user prefers reduced motion.

loop.script: hover[0] → focus[0] → blur[0] → idle → hover[1] → idle
